title: Weapons System 119L / Genetrix Operational Opportunity Audit
purpose: Separate what the official SAC history establishes about launch opportunity and aggregate activity from what remains unavailable at daily row level, so no invented launch calendar can enter Blue Book/POSS-I inference.

authority.title: SAC Historical Study 62 — History of 1st Air Division, Volume 2
authority.public_authority: CIA FOIA / declassified Strategic Air Command history
authority.source_freeze_status: CIA_REMOTE_BYTES_FAIL_CLOSED_REDIRECT_LOOP; authority text remains publicly indexed but no raw CIA byte hash is claimed by JANUS.

established_operational_facts.fact: Eight effective balloons were launched on 1956-01-10.
Subsequently balloons were launched daily at rates consistent with directed limitations, further limited by political considerations and surface weather.
Directed maximum effective launches/day: 10 until 1956-01-17; 20 from 1956-01-17; 30 from 1956-01-25; 40 from 1956-01-28.
Launch operations were suspended and later resumed on 1956-02-03 when required conditions existed.
The history states that 184 balloons were successfully launched on and after 1956-01-25 in the aggregate analysis discussed in the report.
The report table of contents references Chapter VI — IBM Machine Run and Chapter III Tab M — Statistics, indicating a more granular statistical layer existed in the original report lineage.

forbidden_reconstruction: Do not assign the daily maximum launch limits as actual launch counts.
Do not distribute the aggregate 184 successful launches across dates by interpolation or optimization.
Do not assume every calendar date after 1956-01-10 was a launch date merely because the prose says launches were normally daily.
Do not infer zero launches from missing row-level data.
Do not use the operational window as a date-level exposure in Blue Book or POSS-I statistics.
next_source_targets: Search for companion/other volumes of SAC Historical Study 62 containing Chapter III Tab M Statistics or Chapter VI IBM Machine Run.
Search Air Force Cambridge Research Center / 1st Air Division / 1110th Air Support Group companion statistical records for flight-number/date/launch-site rows.
Only after a row-level manifest is frozen may 119L enter confirmatory Blue Book/POSS-I date-level inference.
